preconditions.description: The number of nodes n must be between 2 and 200,000.
The number of queries q must be between 2 and 200,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and 1 <= ci <= 1000000 for ai, bi, ci in edges)
preconditions.description: All edges must have valid node indices and weights within the specified range.
The number of edges must be exactly 2n - 2.

preconditions.expression: all(bi == 1 for ai, bi, ci in edges[n-1:])
preconditions.description: The last n - 1 edges must all point to node 1.

postconditions.description: For type 2 queries, the output must be the length of the shortest path from node u to node 1.
For type 2 queries, the output must be the length of the shortest path from node u to node v.

invariants.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n and 1 <= ci <= 1000000 for ai, bi, ci in edges)
invariants.description: The edges must maintain valid node indices and weights.
The number of edges must remain 2n - 2.

invariants.expression: all(bi == 1 for ai, bi, ci in edges[n-1:])
invariants.description: The last n - 1 edges must continue to point to node 1.
